title: OpenClaw worker contract
description: The orchestrator <-> worker interface for Day 6 (plan.yaml task day6_block2_worker_contract, source 0:00-0:20). A worker invocation has two halves: an input message the orchestrator dispatches to a worker, and an output message the worker returns. Every architectural promise about 'agents' hinges on this contract being clean. Validate a single message against #/$defs/worker_input or #/$defs/worker_output; a message validating against this root schema is exactly one of the two (the two sub-schemas are mutually exclusive because each forbids additional properties and their required fields are disjoint).

worker_input.title: Worker input
worker_input.description: What the orchestrator dispatches to a worker. Required fields are exactly task_id, task_type, payload, parent_request_id.

task_id.description: Unique id for this task, assigned by the orchestrator. Echoed back in worker_output.task_id so a result can be matched to its dispatch.

task_type.description: Worker capability to invoke. Day 6 defines exactly one task type: 'summarize_paper'. An unknown task_type is a clean rejection (worker_output.status == 'error'), not a crash.

payload.description: Task-type-specific arguments. For task_type 'summarize_paper': {"arxiv_id": <string>} -- the worker retrieves that paper's abstract from the papers_recent collection and asks Gemma 4 to summarize it in ~100 words.

parent_request_id.description: request_id of the call that spawned this task; null for a top-level task. When a string, a uuid4. Used to reconstruct the causal chain orchestrator -> worker -> wrapper -> vLLM (see tools/inspect_run.py, Day 6).

worker_output.title: Worker output
worker_output.description: What the worker returns to the orchestrator. Required fields are exactly task_id, status, result, errors, jsonl_log_path.

task_id.description: Echoes worker_input.task_id. On a rejection where the input had no usable task_id, the orchestrator substitutes a non-empty placeholder so the output stays well-formed.

status.description: 'passed' = worker completed and result is populated. 'error' = the task was rejected or failed cleanly (malformed input, unknown task_type, worker exception caught) -- errors is non-empty. 'timeout' = the worker exceeded the orchestrator's 60 s worker timeout.

result.description: Worker output on success; null when status != 'passed'. For task_type 'summarize_paper': {"arxiv_id": <string>, "summary": <string>}.

errors.description: Human-readable error strings. Empty when status == 'passed'; non-empty when status is 'error' or 'timeout'.

jsonl_log_path.description: Path to the orchestrator JSONL log (logs/orchestrator.jsonl) holding this task's causal chain: orchestrator dispatch -> worker invocation -> orchestrator receipt, linked by parent_request_id.
